items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: And I think a clarinet player you called Big Eye Louie. That's all I knew, Big Eye Louie.

ctx.x: She was the only teacher out there. Dr. Nelson was a very nice man. Very nice.
You know, Bunk Johnson always called him Louie Nelson. They always called him Dr. Nelson's son, is the way I always spoke of him.
Oh yeah, Bunk Johnson. Now by the way, speaking of Bunk Johnson-
